stepTitle: Which point is located at an angle of $$\frac{-7\pi}{3}$$ radians? \n A unit circle on a coordinate plane with $$x$$ and $$y$$ axes. Four points, labeled A, B, C, and D, are positioned along the circumference. Point A is in the top-right quadrant, one-third of the way along the upper half circlular arc starting from the positive x-axis. Point B is in the top-left quadrant, two-thirds of the way along the same upper half circlular arc. Point C is in the bottom-left quadrant, one-third of the way along the lower half circlular arc starting from the negative x-axis. Point D is in the bottom-right quadrant, two-thirds of the way along that same lower half circular arc. The four points are vertically and horizontally aligned with each other.
